simple.meaning: properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כִּידוֹן (H3591) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart
definitions.full: H3591. kidon I. כִּידוֺן noun [masculine] dart, javelin (Late Hebrew id. ) — absolute ׳כ Josh 8:18 6 t.; כִּידֹן Jer 50:42 ; construct כִּידוֺן 1Sam 17:6 ; — dart, javelin (distinct from חֲנִית spear, lance , q. v.), בַּכּ ׳נטה (ךׅ ביד אשׁר Josh 8:18 (twice in verse), compare 8:26 ; כּ ׳רַעַשׁ Job 41:21 the rushing sound of a dart ; וּבְכ ׳וּבַחֲנִית בְּהֶרֶב 1Sam 17:45 (weapons of Goliath), כְּתֵפָיו בֵּין נְחשֶׁת ׳כ 17:6 ( חֲנִית in 17:7 ); + חֲנִית Job 39:23 also; וְכ ׳קֶשֶׁת Jer 6:23 ; 50:42 .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3589 ; (perhaps smaller than 2595 )
